name: flightdeck
description: Flightdeck: a minimal developer HUD for Claude Code. Model and effort controls, usage and context meters, chat history with side-by-side diffs, extension usage, and compact edit rows.

compactEdits.title: Compact edit rows
compactEdits.description: Hide code diffs in the chat and show the action, repository, file and line counts instead. ctrl+o still shows the full change.

openOnStart.title: Open the panel at session start
openOnStart.description: Open the control panel beside the chat when a session starts, if the terminal is wide enough.
